name: APCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's own top singles belt, contested for at a future show by the winner of a twenty-man battle royal staged on its own 9 June 1999 pay-per-view.

name: APCW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: A brawling singles belt that changed hands inside a rented bank on the federation's own 9 June 1999 pay-per-view, ending its former two-time holder's run with the company.

name: APCW Television Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles belt that changed hands on the federation's own 9 June 1999 pay-per-view after a former rival's ringside run-in turned the match.

name: APCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The federation's own tag championship, retained by disqualification on its own 9 June 1999 pay-per-view.
